description: Bounded convergence SLO for the fleet quarantine + revocation propagation surface. Declares the partition profile + fleet size + target convergence percentile + target wall-time the harness (B.1) must satisfy before FE-CLAIM-005 can promote from TARGETED to OBSERVED.

secondary_slos.rationale: Single AZ-equivalent loss; convergence still required but with relaxed deadline.
Post-partition recovery lane; deadline allows for connectivity restoration + state reconciliation.

unsupported_profiles.permanent_split: Convergence is mathematically impossible under permanent network split; the gate correctly refuses to publish an SLO that would imply otherwise (covered by bd-cixqu.2.6).
unsupported_profiles.split_brain: Two-leader scenario violates the single-source-of-truth assumption that the convergence SLO is conditional on; refused for the same reason as permanent_split.
